name: chat-form-dropzone
title: Chat File Dropzone
description: A chat-style composer bar: a paperclip opens the picker, chosen images line up as thumbnails and a message box sits alongside. Four images of 1MB are the cap.
use: A message composer should let the sender attach a few pictures without leaving the bar.
avoid: Fixed 384px width and hardcoded limits; the attachment row has no explanatory copy.
a11y: The file picker has a hidden label, but the message box relies on its placeholder alone. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded dark bar with a thin border holding a paperclip button in a light square and a placeholder message line. Once images attach, small square thumbnails join the paperclip and the message field drops to a full-width second row.
behaves: Picking or dropping images adds small square previews beside the paperclip, each with a remove X, and pushes the text field onto its own row. Clicking the paperclip opens the file picker.
customise: No props: the limits, accepted types, placeholder and both layouts sit inside the file.
weight: light: A paperclip picker, an input and up to four thumbnails; no loops.
demo: Placeholder "Your message here..." with two blue and orange gradient sample images
issues: The message input is not connected to state, so typed text goes nowhere.
polishWhy: Neat two-row layout that adapts to attachments; a dead input and fixed width hold it back.
